notes.title: The Courier is Getting Pushed Back until 2023
notes.notes:
Hey all, 

We've heard your feedback over the course of months and have decided to change up how The Courier performs as well as how we approach the gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42193791/319b018fa690ae1007d985b0706f8d8a0606a3eb.jpg[/img]

The Courier will now be set to release sometime in 2023 and we will be sure to provide clear communication moving forward about its release.

notes.title: The Courier Steam Next Fest Demo!
notes.notes:
Hello Couriers in training!

For the Steam Next Fest, we've squashed some reported bugs, and made the demo overall a better experience! Check the fixes below.

[list]
[*]Fixed the first npc that asks you to deliver his letter dialogue so now you won't be stuck on it
[*]Fixed the lock kid part, it would be automatically completed so you didn't have to open the gate
[*]Fixed a glitch where you could spam the ringbell in the office and get a ton of quests lol
[*]Fixed a major bug that made you stuck in henry's cave
[*]Added 960x540 resolution
[*]Fixed a bug where you wouldn't see the speech bubble when trying to buy glasses without money
[*]Added a button to set the game in windowed mode
[*]Changed the behavior for the camera movement on dialogues, now it won't zoom out and in for each bubble.
[*]Added support for arrow keys for movement and menu
[*]Added support for enter for interaction keys[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933200/The_Courier_Demo/

Enjoy!
📨

notes.title: The Courier Demo Has Been Delivered!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42193791/99a74ead078674f5de440bb1dde959783655718d.png[/img]

Hello our little couriers in training! We're pleased to announced that The Courier demo is now available on Steam! Explore the wonderful island of Orda in The Courier Demo! Walk your dog, ride a bicycle, deliver the mail.

Meet friendly characters and help them do their chores! Give the Courier Demo a try!
